crossRefs.note: A certain man who was lame from his mother’s womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple…
There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years, because he was paralyzed.
Behold, a woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;
Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. She was bent over, and could in no way…
A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.
As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.

translations.web: For the man on whom this miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old.
translations.bsb: For the man who was miraculously healed was over forty years old.
translations.kjv: For the man was above forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was shewed.
translations.asv: For the man was more than forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was wrought.
